name: Hotel Locarno
summary: A true-luxury pick: the hotel calls itself a five-star, opened in 1925, on Via della Penna.
description: Hotel Locarno is Lina’s true-luxury pick in Rome, not a bargain dressed up as one. The hotel says it opened in 1925, files itself as a five-star, and keeps the address at Via della Penna 22, just off Piazza del Popolo. People come for the history and the roof, not for a loophole in the rate. The figure on this page is the Classic Double or Twin Room Booking.com showed for two adults on 10–11 November 2026, and it is the expensive one on purpose.
